lines: Fine. I'll smooth this wool down for now.
Fine. I'll set this down before it gets heavier.
Fine. I can step back, but do not make me regret it.
All right. We can end this here.
I accept the payment. Keep your distance for a while.
That settles what you owe. It does not make us friends.
I will call this finished and get back to my work.
We are even enough for today.
Take your hands away from your weapon and we are done.
I do not want another fight over this.
The emeralds cover the loss. Let us leave it there.
I can let my anger cool now.
We have an agreement. Stick to it.
This is settled, provided you cause no more trouble.
Go on, then. I have a flock to calm.
I will tell the others you paid what was asked.
No more threats. No more damage. That is the deal.
I am willing to put this behind us.
We can share the same village without testing each other.
I have taken the payment. Walk away peacefully.
That does not cover the tear. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That's short of the full repair. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Not enough. If you want peace, bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and mean it.
Count again. I asked for {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You are still short. The amount is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I cannot accept less than {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The damaged wool cost more than that. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Keep those for now and return with {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
We agreed on {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, not whatever is in your hand.
That will not replace what was lost. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You have not met the price. It is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I am not haggling over this. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The full payment is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. Come back when you have it.
You are close, but close does not mend the damage. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
No. The settlement requires {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I counted carefully. You owe {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Bring the remaining amount until it totals {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
This pile is too small. The price stays {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I will settle when you bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Nothing changes until the full {emerald_cost} {emeralds} are here.
No. The flock still startles when you come near.
No. Some damage has to cool before payment matters.
No. Keep {payment_items}. Trust is not ready to trade.
I will not take payment from you today.
Put {payment_items} away. This cannot be bought off yet.
The village does not feel safe with you here.
You have done too much for emeralds to settle it.
I do not trust the promise behind that payment.
Leave now and give everyone time.
No bargain. Not after what happened.
The flock knows your footsteps and presses against the far rail.
You cannot pay me to forget what I saw.
Keep your offer. I need changed behavior, not items.
I am not ready to stand this close and negotiate.
The others asked me not to deal with you.
This is about safety now, not replacing wool.
Come back after you have made peace with the village.
I will not put a price on fear.
Your payment means nothing while the threats continue.
No. There will be no settlement between us today.
